body:
**Filed by the triage seat (objectstack#6015) as the `objectstack engine` half of a maintainer-ruled cross-repo split. ⛔ Recording a ruling, not making one.**

## The ruling this card carries

objectui#4421, comment `5474563898` — maintainer, 2026-08-31, director batch #13, verbatim 「其他同意」:

> **裁定**:采**选项 A —— 保拼写,跨仓拆分**。2026-08-17 裁定的作者面拼写 `current_user.can(object, verb)` **维持**;实现路线按实测更正:
> 1. **objectstack 半(先行)**:`@objectstack/formula` 在 CEL 引擎函数表注册 `can`(主体从求值上下文取,⛔ 不从 scope bag 取函数值——实测那条路必然 fault);动词别名语义(`update`/`edit`→`allowEdit`、`import`→`allowCreate` …)

The 2026-08-17 ruling on the same card (comment `5321072032`) had approved the author-facing spelling in function form with two riders; a dev then measured that the ruled shape is **not implementable from objectui alone** (report `5473068187`, `premise_still_valid: false`, no PR, no code, branch pushed empty as a write-route probe). Batch #13 is the correction: the spelling stands, the implementation splits, and **this repo goes first**.

objectui#6941 (ruled B, same day, batch #12) points at the same seam from the other side and records the join: 「`can` 在 objectstack formula 注册引擎函数落地后,本枚举集相应收缩」.

## Measured state of this repo — 2026-09-16T23:10Z

> ⚠️ **Correction, made by the filing seat within minutes of filing.** This heading first read `23:12Z`. That time was *typed from memory*, not read from a clock — the clock at the moment of filing said `23:10Z`. The readings below are unchanged and were re-taken against a read clock before this correction (`can` registrations: **0**; control registrations `now`/`upper`/`lower`: **5**). A stamp nobody read is not a reading, even when the number it carries turns out to be close.

`can` is **not** registered, and the repo's own tests pin that it is not:

| reading | result |
|---|---|
| `grep -rn "^\s*(can\|now\|upper\|lower\|contains\|startsWith)\s*:" packages/formula/src` | `now`, `upper`, `lower` present; **`can` absent** |
| `packages/formula/src/unknown-function.test.ts:77` | asserts `firstUnknownFunctionCall('current_user.can(object, verb)')?.name === 'can'` — i.e. `can` is an **unknown** function today |
| `packages/formula/src/validate.test.ts:289` | asserts `nearestName('can', CEL_STDLIB_FUNCTIONS) === 'min'` — `can` is not in the stdlib catalog |

**Firing control**: the same grep, in the same files, returns the registered names `now` / `upper` / `lower`, so the zero on `can` is the instrument working, not the instrument dead.

⚠️ Note for whoever lands this: those two test assertions **encode the absence**. They are not incidental — `validate.test.ts:274` carries a comment reasoning about the `nearestName('can', …)` distance. Registering `can` will turn them red by design; updating them is part of this card, and ⛔ deleting them instead of re-pointing them is not.

## Scope

- Register `can` in the CEL engine function table of `@objectstack/formula`.
- ⛔ The subject comes from the **evaluation context**, not from a function value on the scope bag — the ruling records that route as measured to fault without exception.
- Verb alias semantics per the ruling: `update`/`edit` → `allowEdit`, `import` → `allowCreate`, and the rest of the alias table as ADR-0068 declares it.
- ⛔ **Not in this card**: the objectui half (the named client-only enum set and its mechanical check, objectui#6941), and the record-level permitted-actions question raised at objectui#4421 comment `5695430738`. That commenter asked whether it should be a separate card; the triage answer, given on #4421, is **yes** — it is a different contract (record-level, not object-level). ⛔ Triage is not writing that card itself: the cloud-side measurement that makes it a finding is held by the commenter, not by this seat, and a card is not filed on someone else's unheld measurement.

## Who is waiting

objectui#4421 is moved to `pm:blocked` against this card in the same round; its unlock condition is `can` resolving in the CEL engine function table here. objectui#6941's enum set shrinks when this lands.
